subject: Having custom login pages for each app

messages.author: 085a1f917bde6c0a
messages.subject: Having custom login pages for each app
parts: Is there a way to set up a custom login page template for each app on Shiny Server pro? We have designed a login page HTML template into the following path: /opt/shiny-server/templates/login.html  but this would obviously impact all apps on the server. If it's possible to create a different template for each app, where should we place the HTML files?
